newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam sells 100 bln dong T-notes, rate 11.95 pct.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam sells 100 bln dong T-notes, rate 11.95 pct.

text.p: Vietnam sold 100 billion dong ($8.57 million) worth of one-year Treasury notes with an annual coupon of 11.95 percent to domestic institutions at an auction on Wednesday, an official at the State Bank of Vietnam said.
At the last sale of government paper, on June 11, the central bank issued 70 billion dong worth of one-year notes at a rate of 11.79 percent.
